title: Robots and Cars of the Future
text:
In the future, robots may help us at home. A robot could clean the floor, cook dinner, and remind us about our homework. Many scientists work on these machines every day. Some people think robots will make life easier.

Cars may also change. Some new cars drive by themselves, without a driver. These cars use sensors to see the road. People can read or rest during the trip.

questions.text: What can a robot do at home, according to the first paragraph?
What do some new cars use to see the road?
Why might people like self-driving cars?
options: They let people relax during a trip
They are slower than normal cars

questions.text: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Technology may change how people live and travel
Cars are bad for the environment
Scientists have stopped working on machines

vocabulary.definition: machines that can do tasks by themselves
devices that detect things such as light, movement or distance
people who study and research how the world works

paragraph_translations: No futuro, os robôs podem nos ajudar em casa. Um robô poderia limpar o chão, cozinhar o jantar e nos lembrar do dever de casa. Muitos cientistas trabalham com essas máquinas todos os dias. Algumas pessoas acham que os robôs vão tornar a vida mais fácil.
Os carros também podem mudar. Alguns carros novos dirigem sozinhos, sem motorista. Esses carros usam sensores para enxergar a estrada. As pessoas podem ler ou descansar durante a viagem.
